sky arts.desc: The story of the life and career of an Academy Award-winning star of the silver screen, known for his roles in Ryan's Daughter, Great Expectations and Hobson's Choice. (S16, ep 5)

sky arts.title: Barry Levinson: The Directors
sky arts.desc: Barry Levinson: The life and career of Barry Levinson, an Academy Award-winning director, is one of success. Take a look back at his contributions towards the film industry. (S7, ep 9)

sky cinema premiere.title: Mistletoe and Mimosas
sky cinema premiere.desc: After Claire inherits her uncle's Christmas-themed bar, she must square off against a neighbouring competitor to save it from its drowning debt.

sky cinema premiere.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
sky cinema premiere.desc: Mario, Luigi and Princess Peach embark on an adventure across the galaxy.

sky cinema premiere.title: Reminders of Him
sky cinema premiere.desc: Released from prison, Kenna tries to reunite with her daughter, but her custodial grandparents refuse to let her see her. She soon finds unexpected compassion from a local bar owner as their secret romance gives Kenna hope for a second chance.

sky cinema action.title: The Fast and the Furious
sky cinema action.desc: An undercover cop infiltrates a gang of LA street racers while investigating a rash of truck robberies.

sky cinema action.title: Enter the Dragon
sky cinema action.desc: A kung fu expert is assigned to penetrate an island fortress to destroy an opium and white slavery empire.

sky cinema action.title: Snakes on a Plane
sky cinema action.desc: An FBI agent must contend with a swarm of deadly serpents that have been released aboard an airliner to kill the witness he is escorting to trial.

sky cinema family.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs 2
sky cinema family.desc: Discovering that his most-famous machine is now creating animal/vegetable hybrids, inventor Flint Lockwood and his friends venture forth to save the world from tacodiles, shrimpanzees and other creatures.

sky cinema family.title: Despicable Me 3
sky cinema family.desc: After being fired from the `Anti-Villain League', Gru travels to Freedonia to meet his long-lost twin brother. Once united the siblings find themselves on a mission to take down a former child star from the 1980s, now out for revenge.

sky cinema comedy.title: Pitch Perfect
sky cinema comedy.desc: When a new student joins her college's female a cappella group, she takes the women out of their comfort zone of traditional pieces and introduces them to innovative arrangements.

sky cinema comedy.title: Pitch Perfect 2
sky cinema comedy.desc: Now graduating seniors, the Barden Bellas enter an international a cappella competition which no American team has ever won.

sky cinema comedy.title: Pitch Perfect 3
sky cinema comedy.desc: After the highs of winning the world championships, the Bellas find themselves split apart. But when they get the chance to reunite for an overseas USO tour, this group of awesome nerds will come together to make some music one last time.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Anaconda
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: The film crew for a nature documentary on a legendary tribe of the area is hijacked by Sarone, a madman intent on capturing the biggest snake in the Amazon, but since reptiles don't grow to 40 feet without eating, who's hunting whom?

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Men in Black: International
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: The Men in Black have expanded to cover the globe, but so have the villains of the universe. When aliens that can take the form of any human arrive on Earth, H and M embark on a globe-trotting adventure to save the agency -- and ultimately the world.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Gator Creek
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Vacation turns disaster when Kyle and her friends escape a plane crash in the desolate Louisiana everglades, only to discover there's something more dangerous lurking in the shallows.

sky cinema thriller.title: RocknRolla
sky cinema thriller.desc: Small-time crooks One Two and Mumbles decide to legitimately invest in some prime real estate and find themselves out of their depth and in debt to old-school London gangster Lenny Cole. Cole himself is in the middle of a business deal with a Russian gangster, but when his accountant tips off One Two and Mumbles to the details of an upcoming big-money business transaction, the two scallywags swoop in and steal the cash.

sky cinema thriller.title: Jaws
sky cinema thriller.desc: Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.

sky cinema thriller.title: Jaws 2
sky cinema thriller.desc: Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.

sky cinema greats.title: Logan's Run
sky cinema greats.desc: In 2274, computers rule a hermetically sealed city housing the survivors of a holocaust that has decimated the earth. Life is hedonistic and happy for the city's inhabitants; unfortunately they must be terminated when they reach 30. When Logan 5, a trained hunter for the system, grows intrigued by a beautiful young woman, he is forced to question the fundamental principles of his society and decides he must flee.

sky cinema greats.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
sky cinema greats.desc: Sequel unfolding a life-and-death battle to avert a nuclear holocaust. A supercomputer that sought to destroy humankind sends a virtually indestructible, shape-shifting cyborg back to our time to kill its enemy - the human resistance leader - in his youth. Aided by another cyborg, the boy and his mother try to alter the events that led to the computer's creation and the nuclear war which it triggered.

sky cinema drama.title: I, Tonya
sky cinema drama.desc: In 1991, talented figure skater Tonya Harding becomes the first American woman to complete a triple axel during a competition. In 1994, her world comes crashing down when her ex-husband conspires to injure Nancy Kerrigan, a fellow Olympic hopeful, in a poorly conceived attack that forces the young woman to withdraw from the national championship. Harding's life and legacy instantly become tarnished as she's forever associated with one of the most infamous scandals in sports history.

sky cinema drama.title: Song Sung Blue
sky cinema drama.desc: Two down-on-their-luck performers form a Neil Diamond tribute band, proving it's never too late to find love and follow your dreams.

sky cinema drama.title: Terms of Endearment
sky cinema drama.desc: While widow Aurora fends off a stream of admirers, daughter Emma learns the hard facts of married life.

sky cinema drama.title: Stand by Me
sky cinema drama.desc: Bittersweet film about a gang of four 12-year-old boys growing up in Oregon in the 1950s. The story is told in flashback years afterwards by one of the boys - now a writer - and revolves around their search through the countryside around their hometown for the body of a missing teenager, thought to have been killed by a train. Adapted from `The Body', a novella by Stephen King.
